checks_run.procedure:
FE13 / D-075 user outcome, in a real browser, EN (LTR) and AR (RTL), with my new probe r15-identity-ui.mjs.
S1 (the F-DG2-500 path):
- A (dev.lead) opens /login?returnTo=%2Fmy-work and clicks the wordmark, which pushes an in-document /login entry. A signs in and sees an A-only transformation on Transformations.
- A's session ends outside the page. The tab goes Back to the in-document /login entry (no document load), and its /me re-probe gets 401.
- B (dev.nobody) signs in with the form in the same tab. B's list requests are delayed 3 s, so any cached A record would be what the screen shows.
- Every 100 ms for about 5 s on My work and on Transformations, check that neither A's record nor A's name is shown.
S2 (identity changes in another tab, with no 401 in this tab):
- Tab 2 signs A out with the button and signs B in.
- Tab 1 regains focus after /me is stale. Check that it shows B's name, never with A's record, and that A's record and name are gone.
checks_run.command: TAG=raised-limits bash with-stack.sh bash runp.sh r15-identity-ui (stack-run-4b); PACE_MS=62000 TAG=default-limits bash with-stack-default-limits.sh ... runp.sh r15-identity-ui:r15-identity-ui-default-limits (stack-run-5)
checks_run.environment: disposable stacks; Chromium; raised and default (product) rate limits; synthetic users
checks_run.expected: S1: 0 samples showing A's record or name to B in EN and AR; B's name shown; correct dir. S2: after the refocus /me, B's name is shown and A's record and name are gone, never shown together with B. No page errors.
checks_run.actual:
Final runs: 13/13, exit 0, with raised limits (stack-run-4b) and with default limits (stack-run-5).
- S1 EN and AR: 46-49 samples on My work and 39 on Transformations each show A's record 0 times and A's name 0 times. B's name 'Synthetic User Without Roles' is shown, with dir ltr and rtl. Back reached /login?returnTo=%2Fmy-work with 0 document loads.
- S2 EN and AR: tab 1 made 1 /me request after the refocus. B's name is then shown, A's record and name are gone at the end, and both=0 (never together).
Earlier attempts, each kept and explained (all probe mistakes, none product failures):
- attempt 1 exit 1 (crash 'Execution context was destroyed'): the wordmark Link to the current location replaces instead of pushing, so history.go(-2) hit about:blank.
- attempt 2 exit 1: the saved profile language overrode my pre-sign-in language click, so the EN pass ran in Arabic. S2 then timed out looking for an EN 'Sign out' button. S1 had passed.
- attempt 3 exit 1 (11 PASS, 2 FAIL: en/ar.S2.tab1-after-identity-change): the refocus came within the 15 s staleTime, so nothing refetched and tab 1 kept A's own screen (both=0).
- attempt 4 exit 1 (same 2 FAILs): after 16 s the list refetched under B's cookie, and A's record disappeared (both=0). But GET /me has staleTime 60 s and was not re-asked (tab1MeAfterRefocus=0), so A's name stayed in tab 1's header. I record this as an observation in the narrative, not a finding: no record of A's is shown to B; the stale label is A's own name in a tab A left open, for at most 60 s, and it self-corrects. The final run waits 61 s.
Wrapper stack-run-4-attempt1.log EXIT=1 comes solely from r15 attempt 1. stack-run-4b-attempt2/3/4 logs EXIT=1 are those attempts.

summary: PASS, no new findings. FE13 / D-075 delivers its user outcome in a real browser, in EN and AR, with raised and with default rate limits. When A's session ends while the sign-in page is shown (Back to an in-document /login entry) and B signs in in the same tab, B never sees A's record or A's name: 0 of about 85 samples per language, with B's list deliberately delayed 3 s. An identity change made in another tab purges A's data as soon as tab 1 re-asks /me. Sign-in, sign-out, the session-ended message, the language notice, and the Team, Evidence and Design screens are correct in EN (ltr) and AR (rtl). The full re-review of the 26 requirements against playbook B0009, B0018, B0023, B0029, B0035, B0037, B0039-B0043, B0056 and B0062 passed, static and live: G1 to G3 advance sequentially with B0023 names, Arabic RLM text is kept verbatim, invisible-only values are refused with localized messages, and an evidence upload downloads byte-identical. The invariants are intact. Typecheck, build, lint, test (866/866) and contrast pass on Node 22 and 24. One observation, not raised as a finding, is in the narrative: GET /me has a 60 s staleTime, so after an identity change in another tab, tab 1 may show the previous person's name over refetched data for up to 60 s.
